steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Grease the bottom and sides of a square 9-inch pan.
Core and slice 4 medium apples.
Spread the sliced apples on the bottom of the pan.
Cut 1/4 cup of margarine into small pieces in a medium bowl.
Add 1/4 cup of quick oatmeal and 1/4 cup of flour to the bowl.
Add 1/2 cup of brown sugar and 1 tablespoon of cinnamon.
Cut the margarine into the mixture with two knives, until it looks like small crumbs.
Sprinkle the mixture over the top of the apples.
Bake in the oven for about 20 minutes.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Food Hero, Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service

ingredients.name: cauliflower rice, grated or finely chopped, about half a medium head

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 400 °F.
Lightly grease a baking sheet.
Mix 2 cups of cauliflower rice, 1 egg and 3 tablespoons of flour in a medium bowl.
Mix in 1/4 cup of grated cheddar cheese and 1/4 teaspoon of salt.
Press the mixture into about 15 small balls or logs.
Put the tots on the baking sheet with space between each one.
Bake for 20 minutes, until cooked through.
For extra crispy tots, broil them for 2 more minutes.
steps.spoken: For extra crispy tots, broil them for 2 more minutes. Watch closely so they do not burn.

source.name: NHLBI (NIH)
source.credit: NHLBI, NIH; Heart Healthy Home Cooking African American Style

ingredients.name: cornflakes, crumbled, or regular bread crumbs

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 475 °F.
Drizzle 1 tablespoon of lemon juice on 2 pounds of fish fillets.
Pat the fish dry.
Mix 1/4 cup of buttermilk, 2 drops of hot sauce and 1 teaspoon of garlic in a bowl.
Mix 1/4 teaspoon each of white pepper, salt and onion powder with 1/2 cup of cornflakes.
Spread the seasoned cornflakes on a plate.
Let a fillet sit briefly in the buttermilk mixture.
Coat the fillet on both sides with the seasoned crumbs.
steps.spoken: Coat the fillet on both sides with the seasoned crumbs. Let it stand briefly until the coating sticks to each side. Repeat for all the fillets.

steps.instruction: Arrange the fillets in a lightly oiled shallow baking dish.
steps.spoken: Arrange the fillets in a shallow baking dish lightly oiled with the vegetable oil.

steps.instruction: Bake for 20 minutes on the middle rack without turning.
Cut the fish into 6 pieces.
Serve with fresh lemon wedges.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Heart Healthy Home Cooking: African American Style, US Department of Health and Human Services, National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute

steps.instruction: Trim the fat from the 6 pork chops.
Place the chops in a 13x9 inch baking pan.
Spread 1 medium sliced onion over the chops.
Spread 1/2 cup of green pepper and 1/2 cup of red pepper on top.
Sprinkle with 1/8 teaspoon of black pepper and 1/4 teaspoon of salt.
Refrigerate the pan for 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 375 °F.
Cover the pan.
Cook for 30 minutes.
Uncover the pan and turn the chops over.
Cover the chops again with the onions and peppers.
Cook for 15 more minutes, until a thermometer reads 145 °F.
steps.spoken: Cook for 15 more minutes, until a thermometer reads 145 °F in the thickest part of a chop.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Put 1/3 cup of margarine in a small saucepan.
Melt the margarine on low heat.
Put 3 ripe bananas, the melted margarine and 2 cups of oats in a mixing bowl.
Add 1/4 cup of milk, 1/2 cup of raisins and 1 teaspoon of vanilla extract.
Mix really well.
Let the mix stand for 5 minutes, until the oats are wet.
Lightly grease the cookie sheet.
Spoon about 1 tablespoon of dough onto the greased sheet for each cookie.
Bake the cookies for 15 minutes.
steps.spoken: Bake the cookies for 15 to twenty minutes.

steps.instruction: Let the cookies cool on the cookie sheet for 1 minute.
steps.spoken: Let the cookies cool on the cookie sheet for about 1 minute.

steps.instruction: Move the cookies to wire racks or a towel to cool completely.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Pumpkin Post and Banana Beat Newsletters, University of Massachusetts Extension, Nutrition Education Program

steps.instruction: Wash 3 apples.
Core the apples and slice them thinly, with the peel still on.
Mix the apples with 3 tablespoons sugar, 1 teaspoon cinnamon and 1/4 cup water.
Add the apple mixture to a skillet.
steps.spoken: Add the apple mixture to a skillet and cook for 10 minutes.

steps.instruction: Set the apples aside while you make the pancakes.
Beat 2 eggs in a large bowl.
Beat in 1 1/2 cups of milk, 1 tablespoon of honey and 3 tablespoons of oil.
Add 3/4 cup of whole wheat flour, 3/4 cup of flour and 2 teaspoons of baking powder.
Slice 2 bananas and add them to the batter.
Coat a large non-stick pan or griddle with non-stick cooking spray.
Warm the pan over medium heat for 2 minutes.
Spoon 1/4 cup of batter onto the pan for each pancake.
steps.spoken: Spoon 1/4 cup of batter onto the pan for each pancake. You can use more or less batter, depending on the size you want.

steps.instruction: Cook until the tops are bubbly and the edges are dry.
Flip the pancakes and cook 2 minutes, until golden on both sides.
steps.spoken: Flip the pancakes and cook for 2 to three minutes, until they are golden on both sides.

steps.instruction: Put the pancakes on a platter and keep them warm.
Cook the rest of the batter the same way, using more cooking spray as needed.
Serve the pancakes topped with the cooked apples.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: USDA Center for Nutrition Policy and Promotion

steps.instruction: Put 2 cups of papaya chunks in the blender.
Add 2 sliced bananas and 1 cup of yogurt.
Add 1 cup of ice cubes.
Put the lid on tightly.
Blend on a medium setting for 1 minute, until smooth.
steps.spoken: Blend on a medium setting for about 1 minute, until the ice is chopped and the mixture is smooth.

steps.instruction: Serve right away.
steps.spoken: Serve right away, or cover and refrigerate for up to four hours.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: California’s Chefs Cook Lean, Adapted from Lo's Blueberry Coffee Cake, California Department of Health Services

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 400 °F with the rack in the center.
Whisk 1 egg, 1/2 cup of milk and 1/2 cup of vanilla yogurt in a large bowl.
Whisk in 3 tablespoons of canola oil and 2 teaspoons of lemon peel.
Sift 2 cups of flour and 1/2 cup of sugar onto the liquid ingredients.
Sift 4 teaspoons of baking powder and 1/2 teaspoon of salt onto the liquid.
Stir very lightly with a fork, just until everything is combined.
Gently fold in 1 1/2 cups of blueberries.
Pour the batter into an 8- or 9-inch baking pan coated with nonstick cooking spray.
Mix 3 tablespoons of sugar, 1/4 teaspoon of cinnamon and 1/8 cup of walnuts.
Sprinkle the topping evenly over the batter.
Bake for 30 minutes, until the top is lightly browned.
steps.spoken: Bake for 30 to thirty-five minutes, until the top is lightly browned and a wooden toothpick in the center comes out clean.

steps.instruction: Cool the cake in the pan on a wire rack for at least 10 minutes.

ingredients.name: water, for soaking, plus more for cooking
red bell pepper, rinsed and finely chopped

steps.instruction: Rinse 1 pound of dried pink beans and pick out any rocks or debris.
steps.spoken: Rinse the beans and pick through them for rocks and other debris. Throw the debris away.

steps.instruction: Put the beans in a large pot and add 10 cups of water.
Place the pot in the refrigerator and let the beans soak overnight.
Drain the soaked beans.
Put the beans in a large pot with water to cover them by about 1 inch.
Boil gently with the lid tilted for 1 hour, until the beans are soft.
steps.spoken: Boil gently with the lid tilted for about 1 hour, until the beans are soft. If the water drops below the top of the beans, add more water.

steps.instruction: Add 2 medium plantains and 1 large tomato, finely chopped.
Add 1 small red bell pepper and 1 medium white onion, finely chopped.
Add 1 1/2 tablespoons of minced garlic and 1 1/2 teaspoons of salt.
Cook on low heat until the plantains are soft.
Serve warm.
steps.spoken: Serve warm. This makes 16 servings.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Cook 1/2 cup of onion and 1/2 cup of celery in 2 tablespoons of butter.
steps.spoken: In a large pan, cook 1/2 cup of chopped onion and 1/2 cup of chopped celery in 2 tablespoons of butter or margarine, until soft.

steps.instruction: Stir in 2 cups of cooked, chopped chicken and 1 3/4 cups of hot water.
Stir in 2/3 cup of long grain white rice and 1 can of mushrooms with liquid.
steps.spoken: Stir in 2/3 cup of long grain white rice and the 10 ounce can of mushrooms, with their liquid.

steps.instruction: Stir in 1 cup of frozen peas and carrots and 1 teaspoon of dried thyme and rosemary.
Put it all in a covered 8-cup baking dish.
Bake for 30 minutes, until the rice is tender.
steps.spoken: Bake covered for about 30 minutes, until the rice is tender.

ingredients.name: sweet potato, peeled and cut into half-inch chunks
red pepper, cut into half-inch pieces

steps.instruction: Melt 1 tablespoon of butter in a large nonstick pan over medium-high heat.
Add 1 chopped onion and stir for 2 minutes.
Add 2 tablespoons of curry paste and 1 tablespoon of minced ginger.
steps.spoken: Add 2 tablespoons of Thai red curry paste and 1 tablespoon of minced ginger. Cook for 1 minute, stirring.

steps.instruction: Add 1 sweet potato, 1 zucchini and 1 red pepper, all in half-inch pieces.
Add 1/2 cup of water and some salt, then stir.
Cover and cook for 10 minutes, stirring now and then.
steps.spoken: Cover and cook for 10 minutes, stirring now and then, until the vegetables are soft.

steps.instruction: Add 1 can of chickpeas, plus the finely grated zest and juice of 1 lime.
Stir often for 5 minutes, until the liquid has cooked away.
steps.spoken: Stir often for 5 minutes, until the vegetables are tender and the liquid has cooked away.

steps.instruction: Whisk 3 tablespoons of wheat flour into 1 1/2 cups of milk.
Stir the flour and milk into the pan slowly and bring to a simmer.
steps.spoken: Stir the flour and milk into the pan a little at a time, stirring all the time, and bring to a simmer.

steps.instruction: Lower to medium heat and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in 1/2 cup of chopped coriander, and more salt if needed.

ingredients.name: mandarin oranges, including the syrup (14 ounces)

steps.instruction: Add 1 can of mandarin oranges, with the syrup, to a blender.
Add 2 frozen bananas, peeled and sliced.
Add 2 cups of frozen strawberries.
Add 1 1/2 cups of milk.
Hold down the lid and blend on low speed for 30 seconds.
Blend on high speed for 1 minute.
Pour the smoothie into a glass.

ingredients.name: tomatoes, or one 14-ounce can of chopped tomatoes

steps.instruction: Add 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the slow cooker.
Put 1 3/4 pounds of chuck steak in the slow cooker.
Set the slow cooker to high.
Add 1 chopped onion.
Cut 1/4 head of cauliflower into pieces you like.
Add the cauliflower to the slow cooker.
Chop or slice 1/3 of the fennel bulb.
Add the fennel to the slow cooker.
Crush 7 ounces of tomatoes and add them.
steps.spoken: Crush 7 ounces of tomatoes and add them, or add one 14-ounce can of chopped tomatoes.

steps.instruction: Add the rest of the 3 tablespoons of olive oil.
Let it cook for at least 6 hours.
Serve with the rest of the fennel, chopped or sliced.
Bring 1/4 cup of water to a boil.
Stir in the instant coffee until no lumps remain.
steps.spoken: Stir in 1/2 to 2 teaspoons of instant coffee with chicory root. Make sure there are no lumps.

steps.instruction: Bring 3/4 cup of milk to a boil in a saucepan.
Add the coffee mixture to the milk.
Stir in sugar to taste.
Pour the boiling hot coffee into a mug, slowly raising the saucepan as you pour.
steps.spoken: While the coffee is still boiling hot, pour it into a mug or a stainless steel tumbler. Slowly raise the saucepan as you pour, so the coffee falls from a height of about 1 to one and a half feet. This makes the coffee froth like espresso. Be careful, it is very hot.

steps.instruction: If you like, spread a few drops of coffee over the froth with a teaspoon.
steps.spoken: If you like, dip a teaspoon in the coffee and lightly spread a few drops of it over the froth in the mug.

steps.instruction: Serve piping hot.

source.name: NHLBI (NIH)
source.credit: NHLBI, NIH; Stay Young At Heart

ingredients.name: garlic, minced, or 1/8 teaspoon garlic powder
low-sodium red kidney beans, 15 1/2 ounces, drained and rinsed

steps.instruction: Heat 1/4 cup of olive oil in a 4-quart saucepan.
Add 1 clove of garlic, 1 1/3 cups of onion and 1 1/2 cups of celery.
steps.spoken: Add the garlic, onion and celery. Saute for about 5 minutes.

steps.instruction: Add 1 can of tomato paste and 1 tablespoon of parsley.
Add 1 cup of sliced carrots and 4 3/4 cups of shredded cabbage.
Add 1 can of tomatoes and 1 can of kidney beans.
Add 1 1/2 cups of frozen peas and 1 1/2 cups of green beans.
Add a dash of hot sauce and 11 cups of water.
Stir until everything is well mixed.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 45 minutes.
steps.spoken: Reduce the heat, cover, and simmer for about 45 minutes, until the vegetables are tender.

steps.instruction: Add 2 cups of broken spaghetti.
steps.spoken: Add 2 cups of finely broken spaghetti. Simmer for 2 to three minutes only.

steps.instruction: Serve warm.
Chill 4 1/4 cups of water in the fridge until it is very cold.
steps.spoken: Chill 4 1/4 cups of water in the fridge until it is very cold. You can also add ice to make it colder.

steps.instruction: Put the cold water and 1 cup of oats in a blender.
Add 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 2 teaspoons of peanut butter.
Blend on high speed for 15 seconds.
Pour the oat milk through cheesecloth.
